name: virtio-net
why: Stage 4. A different class of device on the same transport, which is
what shows whether the shim generalised or was quietly shaped around
one driver. Forces sk_buff, netdev registration, NAPI and softirqs --
net/ethernet/eth.c is Linux's own: eth_type_trans decides what
protocol a received frame is and how much header to pull off, and
getting that subtly wrong gives packets that look almost right.
